summary: Added Qwen3-VL deep-stack merger LoRA support for the adapter's indexed linear_fc1/linear_fc2 modules. The implementation now assigns deepstack_merger_list weights to their logical layer, allocates buffers from the vision merger's real dimensions, and classifies linear_fc2 as row-parallel. The open upstream PR 32573 was reviewed but not copied because its proposed dimensions do not match the reported adapter tensors and it does not make deep-stack indices discoverable by the loader.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression on the recorded base: dimension resolution and indexed deep-stack merger support were absent (8 failures, 2 passes).
Passing-after regression plus an independent existing model-specific dimension-resolution suite (17 passed).
On gfx950, BF16 rank-32 LoRA projections at the adapter's exact 4608x4608 and 4608x4096 dimensions agreed with an independently computed CPU FP32 reference under explicit tolerances.
All repository formatting, lint, source validation, and registered-test metadata hooks passed.

remaining_limitations: The Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct base weights and 356 MB EditScore adapter were not present in the prepared environment, so a full HTTP server/model-load reproduction and semantic image-generation comparison were not run.
The GPU check validates the reported adapter dimensions and projection arithmetic only; it is not claimed as a full model or serving-path reproduction.
MOSS-VL uses a different vision module hierarchy and was not qualified by the Qwen3-VL-specific adapter evidence in this issue.
